description: This file defines the Minimum class within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library, specifically implementing statistical functions MIN and MINA for spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Minimum
classes.description: A class providing static methods for calculating minimum values according to spreadsheet functions MIN and MINA.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the smallest numeric value from the given list of arguments, ignoring non-numeric values except errors.

methods.name: minA
methods.description: Returns the smallest value including numbers, text, and logical values, according to spreadsheet function MINA.
